result.description: Won or lost, by how much.

efficiency_read.description: What manager efficiency says about the AGENT, separate from luck.

calibration.description: Directional misses only. Magnitude of one week is noise.

decision_grades.description: One entry per decision made last week (from the decision log): was it a good DECISION given what was known, regardless of outcome (§7.3, D7.1).

lessons.description: D7.3 — one sentence each, with the MECHANISM. What to repeat and what never to repeat. Appended to data/lessons.md and read by every future run. Empty most weeks.

league_scan.description: D7.4 — who is selling, who is stacked where we are short, who has a bye crunch. Next week's trade list.

prior_proposals.description: Proposed changes to priors.yaml. Usually empty (§7.3).
